items.problem: CS0122: 'MainWindow.RootFrame' is inaccessible — the agent tried to drive the first navigation from App.OnLaunched via the private RootFrame instead of from inside MainWindow.
items.evidence: mig session-log turn ~77: CS0122 in App.xaml.cs; resolved turns ~78-79 by moving navigation into MainWindow's Activated handler.
items.covered_clearly_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#windowing 'Initialization order — keep MainWindow's constructor inert' (lines ~319-334) shows the canonical MainWindow.xaml.cs pattern navigating from `this.Activated` inside MainWindow — exactly the code that avoids reaching into a private RootFrame from App.
items.why_no_skill_change: The documented pattern already puts the navigation inside MainWindow (its own Activated handler); a re-run following that recipe never accesses RootFrame from App and never hits CS0122. This was a one-off deviation from clearly-shown guidance. (The related 0xC000027B->init-order mapping IS being improved separately as a coverage gap.)
